notes.title: 2.0 Update & 29 Countries!
notes.notes:
[p][b]TITANKIN Prologue 2.0 Patch Notes[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]-The 29 Country Update-[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Somehow, TITANKIN has been played across 29 countries around the world since its release in 2021! I never dreamt it would travel this far outside of Canada, but here we are with players on every continent.[/b][/p][p][b]While hard at work on the next title-I was doing upgrades to the current engine, so I figured what better way to show thanks than to back-port some enhancements into TITANKIN Prologue.[/b][/p][p][b]This is very much a 2.0 patch, with completely refined visuals, fully animated enemies, new cutscenes, slicker UI, and plenty of improvements under the hood.[/b][/p][p][b]This does come with some cost- your old save files will no longer be viable, however I promise the new adventure is worth it.[/b][/p][p][b]Thanks again to each and every one of you who are on this journey with us, whether you’re new to TITANKIN or have been here all along.[/b][/p][p][b]If you’re a fellow patch note enthusiast, continue on to discover all that’s changed in this 2.0 patch for TITANKIN Prologue.[/b][/p][p][b]Please enjoy the game, we’re looking forward to revealing the next reason to party in the near future.[/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]- Chris[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]TLDR Patch Notes for TITANKIN PROLOGUE 2.0[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b]- Graphical update and overhaul across the entire game
- Brand new dialogue portraits for the main cast
- Updated graphical UI in menus, battles, and dialogue[/p][p]- Enemies are now fully animated in battles
- Party members get beefed up battle animations
- New battle UI layout for faster inputs

- Cursor added for clearer selection process in all menus

- Added functionality to Skip Cutscenes
- All cutscenes updated with new animation and camera movement
- Story refreshed with new dialogue & additional cutscenes
- Dialogue UI+Font updated for a more comfortable cutscene experience.

- Skill balance and enemy behaviour slightly more favourable toward the player
- Mostly. Heheh.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]FULL PATCH NOTES:[/b][/p][p][b]The Big Bois
[/b]- Enemies are now much livelier in battle, with boatloads animations. Boatloads!!
- All dialogue portraits updated, with FAR more emotive faces. No botox here.
- Visuals across the board updated, including areas, lighting, characters, portraits, UI… Yeah nearly everything. I got carried away 
- Skippable Cutscenes are HERE!! Hold CANCEL to terminate the story. Reading’s for losers anyway. 
- Story refreshed with new dialogue, some additional cutscenes, and 95%* less typos.   *No promises
- Dialogue UI+Font updated for a more comfortable cutscene experience. For those who DO read.

- New battle UI layout for faster inputs, improved readability, no anchovies.
- Skill balance and enemy behaviour more favourable toward the player usually
 [/p][p][b]Audio
[/b]- Boiling pots and Fireplaces no longer suffer in silence
- Cyr Falls is full of bass. No not THAT bass, the other bass.
- Power Crystal puzzles were given a bit of garlic jazz.
- Various updates to sound effects throughout, as well as some balancing of audio levels.
 [/p][p][b]Bugfixes         [/b]
- You may no longer goad the Dobhar-chú into multiple combat
- Battle Results no longer display a non-scrolling scroll
- Enemies and players now flinch when struck in battle! …weaklings
- Re-aligned some map fx’s chakras 
- Fixed connections between healing items and their special fx
- Previously stoic world objects can now be interacted with properly
- Eidan now benefits from sleeping in a bed
- Eidan no longer calls from the grave when someone else is revived. Sorry Halloweenies[/p][p][b]Gameplay Tweaks
[/b]- Skills slightly more balanced in the player’s favour
- Slight changes to MP restoration formula via DEFEND command
- Enemy AI updated for more engaging combat
- Debuffs now remove buffs, and vice versa. But not vers visa.[/p][p][b]Graphical [/b]
- Overcast skies forecasted in several areas around the island
- Waterier waters all around!
- Added some visual flourishes to the World Map
- Chonky Salamanders! Please continue to watch your step!

- Newly installed Sconces across Cyr
- More robust clotheslines ensure happier laundry days
- Also, clothespins. No more skewered clothes!

- Flowers now dance in the wind, like the happy little flowers they are
- Trees grew additional detail over the last few years. Miraculous!
- Tall grass given a bit more tall[/p][p]- Much additional set dressing, with wholly new and updated assets
- Set dressing now more married to the ground. May they live happily ever after
- Everyone’s got a new face! I was a kind surgeon.[/p][p][b]UI[/b][/p][p]- Small updates to all the menus bringing new colour and sharpness. Watch your fingers!
- New dialogue layouts for a more comfortable reading experience
- Battle UI got shook
- A new animated cursor to point things out
- New journal entries. Shiny and new.[/p][p][b]Writing [/b]
- Most scenes updated for brevity, clarity, or embarrassment. Which is which remains a mystery… 
- Somebody ate all the typos for breakfast. I are sick.
- Extra scenes added, specifically fleshing out the Selites.
- Font updated for legibility
- Dialogue contained to a smaller area for a luxurious reading experience!
-[/p][p][b]????[/b]
- Some extra secrets sprinkled in each dungeon area…
- A handsome new troubadour has wandered into Ildathach[/p]

notes.title: v1.1 UPDATE!
notes.notes:
Who doesn't love patch notes?

[list]
[*]  Added clarity to the Tummyflower mixing mechanic
[*]  Full-Screen toggle option added to the OPTIONS menu
[*]  Bad text sent to the typo jail in the sky
[*]  Fixed hanging that was occurring in some instances during the Victory screen
[*]  Increased performance 
[*]  Minecarts now act like minecarts 
[*]  Salamander Tails now less squishy (but please continue to watch your step! – Ferly)
[/list]

Thank you for playing!
-CM
